description: This file defines the interface for delta encoding operations, including creating, freeing, and applying delta indices and delta data. It contains function prototypes, macro definitions, and inline functions related to delta compression used in data synchronization or version control systems.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Compute index data from a given buffer to facilitate delta operations.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Free the memory allocated for the delta index created by create_delta_index.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Return the memory footprint of a given delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Create a delta from a given index and buffer, with optional maximum size constraint.

methods.name: patch_delta
methods.description: Reconstruct the target buffer from a source buffer and delta data.

methods.name: void * diff_delta(const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)
methods.description: Create a delta representing the difference between source and target buffers.

methods.name: unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
methods.description: Retrieve the header size of delta data, used twice to get source and target buffer sizes.

ctags.name: diff_delta
ctags.signature: (const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)

ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char **datap,$/
